findings.description: Both variants omit an explicitly required vacuum cleaner.
A count belonging to the number of bathrooms is reassigned to a bath and basin although their inventory entries have no confirmed counts.
A structured renovation category conflicts with the source narrative. Both models repeat the structured value. This is not a new invention relative to the prompt.
Different probe seeds produce byte-identical title and body for one holdout property.

additionalObservations: All 12 candidate responses preserve the known monetary roles, mandatory conditions and transport associations on this inspected set.
Some optional building-year, room-independence and kitchen-area details are omitted; the current formal contract does not require every optional field.
Titles and paragraph forms remain regular; a distinct-string count alone is not evidence of rich editorial variety.
The independent review also noted source-only dishware and a bed subtype absent from the frozen request. These input coverage gaps are separate from output hallucinations.
